basic_info.description: This view condo with an expansive, exclusive-use backyard and hot tub is nestled on the gentle slopes of Corona Heights, just moments from Castro and Cole Valley shopping, gyms, dining, entertainment, tech shuttles and all major transit. From the tree lined street, this home's classic 1906 exterior fits well into this highly coveted neighborhood. Upon entering, you'll be greeted by a bright, modern open floor plan with an area for home office. The main living space leads directly out to the exclusive use view backyard complete with covered deck, terrace with a year-round use hot tub and area for a BBQ. The garden is landscaped with lush low-maintenance plants, shrubs, mature trees and has multiple gathering areas with panoramic views that include Twin Peaks, Sutro Tower and Eureka Valley, it is the perfect setting for indoor/ outdoor living and entertaining. The updated kitchen features quartz countertops, marble tile back-splash, Fisher Paykel refrigerator and Viking range & dishwasher. The recently remodeled bathroom has design grade fixtures, finishes and the space feels spacious and spa like. Additional features include in-unit W/D, gas central heating, updated electrical and plumbing, move-in ready, walk-in closet, drip irrigation system and generously sized storage room.
